name: eYantra Corporate Gifting
description: Search and discover products from eYantra's catalog of 500+ corporate gifting items — branded merchandise, employee onboarding kits, and event gifts. Submit bulk quote requests directly from Claude and our team responds with a formal quotation within 4 business hours. Serving 1500+ corporate clients across India since 2000, eYantra ships pan-India with custom logo branding available on all products.

_published_faq.name: How do I add eYantra Corporate Gifting to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add eYantra Corporate Gifting to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.shop.eyantra.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the eYantra Corporate Gifting MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: eYantra Corporate Gifting provides these MCP tools: search_products, get_product_details, get_categories, create_cart, and get_quote_status.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to eYantra Corporate Gifting?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to eYantra Corporate Gifting in e-commerce on the Manufact MCP catalog include Figaro Immobilier, Shop, Get My eSIM, Is It Legit by M8ven, and Pricewatcha.

_published_faq.name: Does eYantra Corporate Gifting MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: eYantra Corporate Gifting does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
eYantra Corporate Gifting is developed by eYantra. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
